claims.text: Pillar B (UpperTheory.Gal.Int.galoisLocalGlobalStrong_recParameter, 95,102 decls, 6.48% of live proof) is the unique non-shared branch feeding Row0b recT into everyCharacter_of_row; it combines galoisRepresentations_of_thetaLift (90,962) and theta-lift engine UpperTheory.TP.K.tLiftK (4,104).

Row0b recT formally constructs a continuous semisimple l-adic Galois representation r : G E Omega ->* GL_a(Qbar l) for any regular algebraic polarized cuspidal automorphic representation pi of GL_a/E over a CM field E, matching Hodge-Tate weights, conjugate-duality, crystalline/pst behavior above l (AboveB), and weakened local-global compatibility away from l (AwayB).

AwayB is strictly weaker than full classical local-global compatibility: (1) it drops small residue primes g <= 16 a^2 via IsQpBig (weakened from IsQp in Row0), and (2) for non-toral parameters (TmW & Sqf & mono0), tame0 only equates characteristic polynomials on inertia elements (deg g = 0) and monodromy vanishing, whereas full equality x = y (including Frobenius) holds under Tor y & y.mono0.

recTExists (595 decls) is a genuine partial Local Langlands correspondence plus an intentional wildly-ramified dummy fallback (junkEx/junkData): LawsT restricts twist, central, dual, depth, and injectivity to Good representations (rank-1 or twists of depth-zero cuspidals over Q_g) plus TypeLaw, while JunkEx assigns a fixed wildly-ramified rep (disjoint from tame/GoodCusp) to non-GoodCusp cuspidals of rank >= 2; CharPolOfInert.mixed_of_tame proves TmW & Sqf & mono0 forces all constituents into Good/DZ, so Row0b recT never evaluates on junkData.

Contrary to naive suspicion from the name EtaleAxioms, GlobalTheory.EtC defines genuine l-adic etale cohomology HQ over Mathlib's Scheme.etaleTopology via injective resolutions of cyclotomic Tate twist sheaves tw q i, and theorems like Et.e4, EtC.b6pic_holds, and etaleCohomology_functorialityAxioms_hold genuinely prove the cohomological properties on schemes rather than axiomatizing cohomology.

Geometric construction (geoOne_holds 82,643) operates ONLY in odd rank a on definite unitary Shimura towers (HTower, PEL Datum), cutting Galois reps out of Hecke eigenspaces (Geo.piece) of l-adic cohomology. Even ranks n are handled by tLiftK (4,104) lifting twice via explicit theta lifts to odd ranks n + t with distinct characters, followed by SplitLineSubtraction (subtractQ_holds) in CoreAll.

IrrGL, WD, IsPlaceOver, CuspSub, PolarizedPair, LocTied/Per.Bcris, and ClassNumberFinite are faithful Mathlib-grounded formalizations rather than empty or vacuous proxies; LocPrime/LocTied and LocBridge are proved unconditionally inhabited by Shared-Diamond theorems exists_locPrime_tied (163) and exists_locBridge.
